lines: CPRG GOVERNANCE FELLOWSHIP

The CPRG Governance Fellowship is a 6-month programme for young leaders passionate about governance and public policy. Through rigorous research, immersive fieldwork, and expert mentorship, fellows gain insights into governance across various policy domains. As fellows delve into their projects, they will have the opportunity to engage directly with governmental agencies, public policy practitioners, and community stakeholders. Our aim is to equip individuals with the foundational skills and knowledge needed to navigate the policy space seamlessly.
CORE ELEMENTS
Rigorous Research
Dive deep into critical policy challenges, conduct thorough research, synthesise data, and craft solutions grounded in evidence.
Practice Driven
Develop the skills needed to translate ideas into action, manage projects efficiently, and deliver real-world impact through immersive learning.
Immersive Fieldwork
Engage directly with governmental agencies, public policy practitioners, and community stakeholders.
Expert Mentorship
Receive personalised guidance and support from experienced professionals and researchers.
Eligibility
Bachelor’s degree in any discipline
Prior experience in governance, research or the development sector is preferred
Stipend
Rs. 25,000/month
Is this programme conducted online or on-site?
This fellowship is conducted entirely on-site. While our office is located in Delhi, fellows will have the opportunity to engage in fieldwork across different locations.
What is the duration of this Fellowship?
This Fellowship is a 6-month programme.
What is the time commitment for the Fellowship?
Applicants should be available and willing to work on a full-time basis (40 hours/week) during the Fellowship.
Who can Apply?

We welcome applications from individuals who have completed an undergraduate degree and possess a keen interest in public policy and governance. Prior experience in governance, research or the development sector is preferred.
Will facilities for accommodation be provided under the programme?
No, we do not offer accommodation.
Can I pursue this programme alongside an academic/professional engagement?
This Fellowship is a full-time engagement.
Will I receive a stipend?
Yes, Fellows will receive a stipend of Rs. 25,000/month during the course of the Fellowship.
Will I get a Certificate on Completion of the Fellowship?
Yes, your certificate will be issued to you upon successful completion of the programme.
